menu.save.title: Save
save.autosave.description: Automatically saves the game on every successful scene change, silently — without the confirmation sound, so it never overlaps a simple door crossing.
save.autosave_interval.description: Automatically saves the game at regular real-time intervals, even while a menu is open. Set to zero, this periodic save is disabled.
save.export_location.choose: Choose where to save the file.
save.export_location.downloads: The file will be created in your downloads folder.
save.exported_download: Game exported: templeton-partie.json, in your downloads folder.
save.import_confirm_title: Importing this game will replace the current game. Confirm?
save.import_confirm_title_saved: Importing this game will replace your current save. Confirm?
save.sound_enabled.description: Plays a confirmation sound on every successful manual or periodic save — never on the silent save triggered by a simple scene change.
